status: Accepted in production source: fixed-cumulus specialization and 160 High sky view samples, with appearance-based qualification. No delivered package change.

quality_direction.user: Overall new clouds have not been in a new release; they may change as long as they still look good.
quality_direction.effect: Appearance and measured performance guide acceptance. Exact native/image equality is retained as diagnostic evidence, not a requirement. Earlier tiny scattering and original renderer A/B variation are not claimed fixed.

source_audit.source_policy: Current production clouds and sky are copied exactly apart from the local Volume preload and removal of EISky class registration; current volume copied byte-identically. Existing PCK supplies other runtime classes.

implementation: High sky specializes exactly fixed cumulus (base .5, spread 0) from the existing density body; other types keep the general body.
High view quadrature changes 192 to160. Half-resolution, five light samples, normal camera and Sky debanding remain. No temporal history or new texture/cache.
Low, sheet clouds, shared reflection/shadow density and independent consumer controls remain. COMMON is byte-identical.

cost.method: Mean of two medians each, ABBA, 256 warmup and 360 samples per arm; actual GPU timestamps, moving cloud clock. Artificial isolated sky, not whole-game FPS.

rejected_budget.reason: Visible increased streaking on fair-cloud edges. Numerical screens passed, but visual review rejected it. Not in production.

gates.cost_image_screen: Numeric candidate screen: mean max-channel delta <2/255 and pixels over8/255 <2%; does not replace visual review. Held/repeat/restored screens allow at most6000 changed pixels and peak4/255 at4K, reflecting recorded original renderer variation.
gates.multi_view_screen: Mean max-channel delta <3/255 and peak <160/255 at1200x675, plus actual image review; three camera/light-direction views, five camera/time steps, three weather cases. Fallback sky colours, not authored-map dusk lighting.
gates.HDR: Direct canvas HDR reference uses the same sample count as candidate and retains exact comparison;110 cases901120 rays per renderer.
gates.platform_limits: Existing Android private runtime lacks ei_sky_subpass_alpha and does not support native High volumes. Initial attempted HDR run stopped at capability guard. Final Mobile and Compatibility fallback tests run current source and restore all private state. Native volumetric Android qualification remains pending a suitable runtime.

android_unsupported_attempt.interpretation: Harness prerequisite failed on installed older QA runtime; not a new runtime or shader crash.

android_capability_correction_2026_10_11.correction: Earlier handoff/quality receipt incorrectly described fallback as missing native alpha capability. The installed engine has ei_sky_subpass_alpha=true. Portability.constrained() is true on Android, so production policy deliberately selects sheet fallback. Native volume remains outside this validation; installing an engine with the same flag does not override platform policy.
